title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the 2026 UN Climate Change Conference in Antalya, Türkiye (COP31)
part_text: 133. Stresses that ensuring an inclusive and socially fair transition to climate neutrality by 2050 requires pragmatic policies that are cost-effective and deliverable, and that prioritise the economically and technically feasible emissions reductions capable of maintaining public support, industrial competitiveness and economic resilience;
